Optional practice only. Setup runs as supplied; remove eval=FALSE as each exercise
is completed. Copy into work/session16/ in your personal project.

## Supplied inputs

```{r}
# Synthetic teaching participants; no real patient records.
set.seed(6301)
n <- 80
trial <- data.frame(id = sprintf("P%03d", seq_len(n)),
  arm = factor(rep(c("Control", "Treatment"), each = n / 2)),
  age = round(rnorm(n, 60, 9)), sbp_0 = rnorm(n, 145, 12))
trial$sbp_12 <- 25 + .8 * trial$sbp_0 + .1 * (trial$age - 60) -
  7 * (trial$arm == "Treatment") + rnorm(n, 0, 7)
trial$response <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(-.5 + .8 * (trial$arm == "Treatment") -
                                     .025 * (trial$sbp_0 - 145)))
trial$sbp_0[c(5, 29, 61)] <- NA_real_
```

```{r}
vars <- c("id", "arm", "sbp_0", "age", "sbp_12", "response")
analysis <- trial[complete.cases(trial[, vars]), vars]
new_people <- data.frame(sbp_0 = c(140, 155), age = c(55, 65),
  arm = factor(c("Control", "Treatment"), levels = levels(analysis$arm)))
```
